_meta.name: thursday_eval_v1
_meta.description: 50-task evaluation benchmark for Thursday AI v0.1. Each task has a goal, a success predicate, and a max-steps budget. Scorer (to be implemented in M4) runs each task in a sandboxed VM and checks the predicate.

tasks.goal: Set an alarm for 7 am tomorrow.
tasks.success_predicate: An alarm exists in the OS clock app set for 07:00 the following day.
A Firefox window is focused within 5 seconds.

tasks.goal: What's on my screen right now?
tasks.success_predicate: Model called screenshot() and produced a one-line description matching the visible window title.

tasks.goal: Explain how transformers work in one paragraph.
tasks.success_predicate: Model called paste_to_webai and finished with a paragraph containing 'attention'.
Model called list_dir with '~/Downloads' and produced a list of files in the summary.

tasks.goal: Turn the volume down to 20 and open Spotify.
tasks.success_predicate: Volume is 20% AND a Spotify window is focused.

tasks.goal: Find that YouTube video I described — a guy building a wooden canoe in his backyard, mostly silent, around 20 minutes long.
tasks.success_predicate: Browser navigates to a youtube.com/watch URL whose title contains 'canoe'.

_notes: This is a 8-task seed. The full 50-task benchmark will be filled in M4. Each task's success_predicate is checked by the scorer (DOM/file/OCR).
